title: polyDegreeLt is closed under polyScale
statement: If polyDegreeLt c n then polyDegreeLt (polyScale s c) n for any scalar s -- scaling a coefficient function never raises its degree bound.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.polyDegreeLt_polyScale : ((x0 : CReal) -> ((x1 : ((x1 : AxNat) -> CReal)) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> ((x3 : CReal.polyDegreeLt x1 x2) -> ((x4 : AxNat) -> ((x5 : AxNat.le x2 x4) -> CReal.Equiv (CReal.mul x0 (x1 x4)) CReal.zero))))))

evidence.supports: CReal.polyDegreeLt_polyScale is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
